items.title: Crown Castle Soars 31% in a Month on SpaceX’s Tower Push: “We’re Talking to All Parties”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle (CCI) stock surged 31% from October 2 to November 2, closing at $87. 03 as SpaceX (SPCX) pursued wireless spectrum and potential tower leases.

items.title: Crown Castle Soars 6% as SpaceX Taps Qualcomm for a “Credible Fourth” Mobile Network
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle stock rose 6% today after SpaceX picked Qualcomm to supply base stations for Starlink Mobile’s US 5G network, starting in 2027. Starlink Mobile will need towers, and a fourth carrier could fill the hole DISH left in Crown Castle’s leasing.

items.title: Wireless Data Demand Is Surging. Why Did Crown Castle Cut Its Dividend 32%?
items.summary: Americans are consuming wireless data at a record pace, yet one of the biggest tower landlords just slashed its dividend by nearly a third. Understanding which tower REITs can still grow their payouts requires a close look at what separates a safe yield from a trap.

items.title: Crown Castle (CCI) Stock May Trade At A Discount On Tower Lease Talks
items.summary: Crown Castle has bounced back on headlines and a sharp short term rally, and the question now is whether the current share price can be supported by the cash it is expected to generate over time. The stock is still down 37.1% over 5 years. This puts the focus on whether the cash flow profile now justifies a different long term valuation story than the one investors have experienced so far.
